Application Data.NAME: Shoe Haven Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Shoe Haven Inc. operates a retail shoe store and repair shop in Springfield, IL, providing a wide range of footwear and accessories for men, women, and children. Our services include shoe repairs, custom fittings, and shoe care products. We prioritize customer satisfaction and maintain a clean, well-organized store environment in compliance with local safety codes. Our experienced staff ensures quality workmanship and has a strong safety record, with minimal incidents reported. We do not engage in equipment rentals or leasing and adhere strictly to industry regulations to mitigate risks.
